# AMNT UI (Ink)

> A free (MIT) design system for Next.js + Tailwind 3.3+ or 4: 50+ accessible React components, Material 3 colour roles, light and dark, 339 Material Symbols icons, app shells. Black and white, square corners, phone first. No component library underneath.

Install: `npx amnt-ui add` (whole kit; wires Tailwind and globals.css), or `npx amnt-ui add button date-picker` for some parts. Parts file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amntio/amnt-ui/main/public/r/ink.json
Import: `import { Button, DataTable, DatePicker } from "@/ui"`, icons from `@/ui/symbols`.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/amntio/amnt-ui/blob/main/README.md): what's inside, install, Figma
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/amntio/amnt-ui/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules and which part to use for what
- [Component index](https://github.com/amntio/amnt-ui/blob/main/ui/index.ts): every export with its props types

## Parts
- Buttons: Button, ButtonLink, IconButton, Fab, Chip, ChipGroup
- Inputs: TextField, Textarea, Select, Search, Checkbox, Radio, RadioGroup, Switch, Slider, SegmentedButton, CodeInput, ColorField, ColorPicker
- Pickers: DatePicker, DateRangePicker, Calendar, MultiSelect, Combobox, IconPicker, IconGrid
- Upload: FileUpload, sendFile
- Data: DataTable, Pagination, Table, List, ListItem
- Charts: LineChart, BarChart, DonutChart, Sparkline, Metric
- Popups: Menu, MenuItem, MenuSub, Popover, Sheet, Window, CommandMenu, Tooltip, toast/Toaster, useConfirm, NotificationBell
- Navigation: Tabs, Breadcrumb, Steps, Accordion, NavigationBar, NavigationRail, NavigationDrawer, NavList
- Shells and layouts: SidebarShell, TopbarShell, AppLayout, SettingsLayout, DetailLayout, AuthLayout, ListDetail, SupportingPane
- Feedback: Alert, Banner, EmptyState, ErrorState, Skeleton, Progress, Spinner, Status, Badge
- People: Avatar, AvatarGroup, Person
- Structure: Card, Panel, Section, PageHeader, SettingsGroup, SettingRow, ActionRow

## Rules
- Colours are roles (bg-surface-container, text-on-surface, bg-primary text-on-primary), never hex.
- Type: text-display|headline|title|body|label-sm|md|lg. Shapes: rounded-small|medium|large|full.
- Breakpoints: medium: 600, expanded: 840, large: 1200, xlarge: 1600.
- One UI source (@/ui); no second component or icon library.
